summary: On July 1, 2026, LEIFRAS Co., Ltd. (the registrant) filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of a stock transfer acquiring SWIFT JAPAN Co., Ltd. from an individual seller. The consideration was paid in cash for all issued and outstanding shares of the target, free and clear of liens. The target operates childcare businesses, which LEIFRAS has commenced operating. Terms such as price per share, premium, and aggregate value were not disclosed. The stock transfer agreement was dated June 23, 2026, and previously filed as an exhibit. No advisors or board recommendations were mentioned. This is a completed acquisition with no pending regulatory or risk-arb angle for watch.
